title: Signature: Purpose-bound access
description: Signature-original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH): every grant names the purpose it serves, and access outside that purpose is denied even when the identity and resource match. Purpose is logged with each access, so audits answer not just who accessed what, but why they were allowed to. At ladder rank 1 (foundation), this record covers binding each grant to a stated purpose.

print("grant purpose:", grant_purpose, "| requested purpose:", asked, "->", "ALLOW" if asked == grant_purpose else "DENY")

title: Signature: Row-level policy compiler
description: Signature-original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH): row-level policies are compiled into efficient filter predicates instead of being evaluated row by row in an interpreter. Compilation happens when policy changes; reads then apply the compiled filter at full speed. Compiled filters are tested against the interpreter for equivalence. At ladder rank 1 (foundation), this record covers compiling policies to filter predicates.
demo:
LEVEL = 1
CFG = {1: 100, 2: 1000, 3: 10000}
N = CFG[LEVEL]
rows = [{"owner": "amy" if i % 2 else "bob", "v": i} for i in range(N)]
pred = lambda r: r["owner"] == "amy"  # compiled filter
got = [r for r in rows if pred(r)]
print("rows:", N, "| visible:", len(got), "| correct:", all(r["owner"] == "amy" for r in got))
provenance: Signature original — designed by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH); Signature-generated completion, clearly labeled.

title: Signature: Policy simulation sandbox
description: Signature-original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH): policy changes are tested in a sandbox against historical requests before deployment. The simulation reports which past decisions would change under the new policy, so unintended consequences are caught before they affect real access. At ladder rank 1 (foundation), this record covers testing policy changes against historical requests.
demo:
LEVEL = 1
CFG = {1: 50, 2: 200, 3: 1000}
N = CFG[LEVEL]
import random
random.seed(31)
flips = sum(1 for _ in range(N) if random.random() < 0.03)
print("historical requests:", N, "| decisions that would flip:", flips, "| deploy:", "BLOCKED" if flips > N * 0.05 else "ok")
provenance: Signature original — designed by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH); Signature-generated completion, clearly labeled.

title: Signature: Minimum-necessary suggester
description: Signature-original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH): the suggester analyzes actual usage and recommends narrower scopes: permissions never exercised are flagged for removal. Recommendations ship with the usage evidence, so owners can approve tightening with confidence instead of guessing. At ladder rank 1 (foundation), this record covers analyzing actual permission usage.
demo:
LEVEL = 1
CFG = {1: {"read": 50, "write": 0, "delete": 0}, 2: {"read": 50, "write": 12, "delete": 0}, 3: {"read": 50, "write": 12, "delete": 3}}
use = CFG[LEVEL]
suggest = [op for op, n in use.items() if n == 0]
print("usage:", use, "| suggest removing:", suggest or ["none - all used"])
provenance: Signature original — designed by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH); Signature-generated completion, clearly labeled.
